# Building physics: catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

Multi-zone airflow, heat and contaminants (CONTAM's physics; CONTAM `.prj`/`.wth`, EPW and Modelica Buildings Library readers). The airflow constitutive laws and heads a building uses come from the core library and are listed here too. How the pieces fit together: [Building physics](../../applications/building/index.md).
Every application is set up the same way; see [Workflow](../../guide/workflow.md).

Import from `noodl.apps.building_physics` and the modules named in each table. Each name links to its entry in the [API reference](../api/index.md), which gives every parameter.

## Network attributes

What the builders, constitutive laws and heads read off `net.add_node(...)` and `net.add_edge(...)`, by name. Defined in `noodl.apps.building_physics.attributes`.

**Nodes**

| Attribute | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `volume` | air volume of the zone (m3); 0 for a wall node | `thermal_layer`, `species_layer` |
| `T0` | initial temperature (K), also the boundary temperature of a boundary node | `initial_state`, `initial_drivers`, `project_to_model` |
| `z_ref` | height of the node's reference pressure (m) | `Stack.from_network` |
| `position` | absolute (x, y, z) of the node's component (m), set by Component.flatten; for drawing only | `noodl.components` |
| `heat_capacity` | extra lumped heat capacity of the node (J/K); a wall node's capacity | `thermal_layer` |
| `in_building_volume` | 1 if the zone counts in the building's conditioned space, 0 if not (CONTAM's zone flag 16, set by the CONTAM reader); absent means 1 | `building_air_change_rate` |

**Edges of kind `airpath`**

| Attribute | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `z_path` | height of the opening (m) | `Stack.from_network` |
| `Cd` | discharge coefficient (dimensionless) | `orifice_law_from_edges` |
| `area` | opening area (m2) | `orifice_law_from_edges` |
| `name` | label of the edge in model.refs and in named results (optional) | `noodl.refs` |

**Edges of kind `airpath`, to or from the ambient node**

| Attribute | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `azimuth` | facade direction, in the unit of the theta_w driver (degrees from CONTAM) | `Wind.from_network` |
| `Cp` | constant wind pressure coefficient when the edge has no profile | `Wind.from_network` |
| `facade` | key of the building's inner_table('facades', ...); flatten writes the facade's azimuth | `Component.flatten` |
| `Ch` | wind speed modifier (dimensionless, 1 by default) | `Wind.from_network` |
| `profile` | number of the WindProfile to use; 0 means the constant Cp | `Wind.from_network` |

**Edges of kind `duct`, a segment between two junctions (made by DuctNetwork)**

| Attribute | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `length` | length of the segment (m) | `duct_laws_from_edges` |
| `diameter` | hydraulic diameter of the duct (m) | `duct_laws_from_edges` |
| `roughness` | roughness of the duct wall (m) | `duct_laws_from_edges` |
| `loss` | sum of the segment's dynamic loss coefficients (dimensionless) | `duct_laws_from_edges` |
| `area` | cross-section of the duct (m2); the circle of the diameter by default | `duct_laws_from_edges` |

**Edges of kind `duct_terminal`, a junction to a zone (made by DuctNetwork)**

| Attribute | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `area` | area of the duct at the terminal (m2) | `duct_laws_from_edges` |
| `loss` | loss coefficient of the terminal (dimensionless) | `duct_laws_from_edges` |
| `z_path` | height of the terminal, the junction's height (m) | `Stack.from_network` |
| `profile` | number of the WindProfile on a terminal in the ambient; absent or 0 for none | `duct_laws_from_edges`, `Wind.from_network` |
| `Cp` | constant wind pressure coefficient of a terminal in the ambient without a profile | `duct_laws_from_edges`, `Wind.from_network` |
| `Ch` | wind speed modifier (dimensionless, 1 by default) | `Wind.from_network` |
| `azimuth` | wall direction of a terminal with a profile (degrees from CONTAM) | `Wind.from_network` |

**Edges of kind `air_handler`, an air handler's edges (made by add_air_handler)**

| Attribute | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `role` | what the edge is: 0 supply point (plenum -> zone), 1 return point (zone -> plenum), 2 recirculation, 3 outdoor air, 4 exhaust | `air_handler_from_edges` |
| `design_flow` | design mass flow of a supply or return point (kg/s); 0 on the other edges | `air_handler_from_edges` |
| `outdoor_air_fraction` | on the recirculation edge: the outdoor-air fraction of the supply when no input sets it (dimensionless, 1 by default) | `air_handler_from_edges` |
| `min_outdoor_air` | on the recirculation edge: the minimum outdoor-air flow (kg/s, 0 by default) | `air_handler_from_edges` |

**Edges of kind `fan`, a constant-mass-flow fan (made by the fan component)**

| Attribute | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `flow` | mass flow delivered from source to target whatever the pressures (kg/s) | `fan_law_from_edges` |

**Edges of kind `wall`**

| Attribute | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `ua` | conductance zone -> wall or wall -> ambient (W/K) | `thermal_layer` |

## Set-up

Build the model and its starting state and inputs.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build_model`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.build_model)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Layers "air" (+ "thermal", + "species"), the density closure, one Model. |
| [`initial_drivers`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.initial_drivers)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A complete driver set: zero boundary pressures, boundary temperatures from each boundary node's `T0` attribute (`T_REF` where it has none), zero boundary mass fractions; then `values`, by name (see `noodl.refs.drivers_from`). |
| [`initial_state`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.initial_state)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `"<layer>.x"` for every transport layer: temperatures from the node attribute `T0` (interior order), mass fractions zero; then `values`. |
| [`project_to_model`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.prj.project_to_model)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Air layer + species layer (no thermal layer: a .prj carries no thermal data), the initial state and the drivers for the project's ambient conditions (or `ambient`). |

## Network components

Descriptions of the physical objects a network is built from.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`AirThroughFilter`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.filters.AirThroughFilter)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The air passing a filter: what a flow-dependent filter's efficiency reads. |
| [`AmbientConcentrations`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.ctm.AmbientConcentrations)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Ambient (outdoor) mass fractions over time: `t` (s from 00:00 of `start_day`, a day of the year), `x` `(len(t), K)` (kg/kg) for the `species` named, in file order. |
| [`Actuator`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Actuator)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Writes block `block`'s output into driver `key` at positions `index` on its last axis (the whole driver when `None`); `mode="add"` adds it to those entries instead (a heat flow into `"thermal.sources"`, W). |
| [`Evaluation`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Evaluation)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | What a block sees: the state the evaluation reads, the drivers, and the step length in s (`None`: an algebraic evaluation that advances nothing). |
| [`Project`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.prj.Project)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A CONTAM project as read by `read_prj`: the network, its airflow laws and head terms, zones and their temperatures and volumes, species, initial mass fractions, sources and ambient conditions, the run control, and the schedules as `inputs`. |
| [`RunControl`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.prj.RunControl)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A project's run control: what to simulate and when. |
| [`Species`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.species.Species)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | One contaminant species: CONTAM's species record. |
| [`WallMass`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.WallMass)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A lumped wall node: capacity [J/K], conductances to the zone and to ambient [W/K]. |
| [`Weather`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.wth.Weather)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A weather series: time `t` (s from 00:00 of the file's start day `start_day`, a day of the year), ambient temperature `Ta` (K), barometric pressure `Pb` (Pa), wind speed `Ws` (m/s) and direction `Wd` (degrees from north, blowing from), and optionally the humidity ratio `humidity_ratio` (kg water / kg dry air) and each day's CONTAM day type `day_types` {day of year: 1-12}. |
| [`Zone`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.Zone)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A room: its air `volume` (m3), initial temperature `T0` (K), reference height `z_ref` (m) and an optional lumped `wall` (`WallMass`). |

## Constitutive laws

The relation between the flow through an edge and the potential difference across it.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`AffinityFan`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fan.AffinityFan)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A fan curve run at another speed and air density, by the fan laws (ContamX's performance-curve fan). |
| [`AirDuct`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.air_duct.AirDuct)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A duct segment, F (kg/s) from dp (Pa): Darcy-Weisbach with ContamX's friction factor. |
| [`Conductance`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.conductance.Conductance)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | q = g dp, the linear branch law used for thermal conduction and passive exchange; `g` is in the flow unit per unit of potential (W/K for heat, kg/s per Pa for air). |
| [`CubicSplineFlow`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.curve.CubicSplineFlow)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | An airflow element given by measured points, fitted as ContamX fits them (`SplineCurve`): CONTAM's cubic-spline elements. |
| [`Damper`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.damper.Damper)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Separate power-law coefficient and exponent for each flow direction: `C_pos`/`n_pos` for dp > 0 and `C_neg`/`n_neg` for dp < 0, each as in `PowerLaw` (`C` in the flow unit per Pa^n, `n` dimensionless). |
| [`DoorCompartment`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.DoorCompartment)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One compartment of ``Buildings.Airflow.Multizone.DoorDiscretizedOpen`` per edge. |
| [`DoorPortStream`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.DoorPortStream)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One port stream of a whole discretised door, as one edge from side A to side B. |
| [`Duct`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.duct.Duct)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Colebrook duct: F(dp) with friction from the Colebrook equation, laminar below Re_t. |
| [`DuctTerminal`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.air_duct.DuctTerminal)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A duct terminal, the zero-length duct between a junction and its zone, F (kg/s) from dp (Pa), as ContamX computes it. |
| [`FanCurve`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fan.FanCurve)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Cubic pressure-flow curve inverted for q given dp on [0, q_max]: `coeffs` are (a0, a1, a2, a3) of P(q) = a0 + a1 q + a2 q^2 + a3 q^3 in Pa for q in the flow unit, and `q_max` is the largest flow the curve covers, in that unit. |
| [`FixedFlow`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fixed.FixedFlow)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | q = q0 regardless of dp (`q0` in the flow unit); dflow = 0; linear_init = (q0, 0). |
| [`FixedVolumeFlow`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fixed.FixedVolumeFlow)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | F = Q rho_up whatever dp: a constant volume flow `volume_flow` Q (m3/s, one per edge) delivered as mass flow at the density of the node it draws from (`src` when Q >= 0, `tgt` otherwise), read from `drivers[rho_key]` (full node order). |
| [`OpenDoor`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door.OpenDoor)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | ``Buildings.Airflow.Multizone.DoorOpen``: one direction of the always-open door. |
| [`OperableDoor`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door.OperableDoor)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | ``Buildings.Airflow.Multizone.DoorOperable``: the door blended between open and closed by the opening signal ``y`` read from ``drivers[y_key]``. |
| [`OperableDoorCompartment`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.OperableDoorCompartment)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One compartment of ``Buildings.Airflow.Multizone.DoorDiscretizedOperable`` per edge, blended between the open door and the closed crack by ``y = drivers[y_key]``. |
| [`PowerLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw.PowerLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | q = C sign(dp) \|dp\|^n, laminar-blended or smoothly regularised near dp = 0. |
| [`PrescribedFlow`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fixed.PrescribedFlow)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | F = drivers[key] whatever dp: a flow (kg/s, one value per edge of the kind) that a closure or an input prescribes every step, e.g. an air handler's supply flows. |
| [`Quadratic`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.quadratic.Quadratic)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | q = sign(dp) * 2\|dp\| / (sqrt(a^2 + 4 b \|dp\|) + a): the inverse of dp = a q + b \|q\| q, with `dp` in Pa, `a` in Pa per flow unit and `b` in Pa per flow unit squared. |
| [`RegularizedPowerLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.RegularizedPowerLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | MBL's regularised power law, ``q = C sign(dp) \|dp\|^m``, volume or mass form. |
| [`Scaled`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.scaled.Scaled)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | F = s F_law: `law`'s flow times the dimensionless multiplier `drivers[key]`. |
| [`SplineFlowTable`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.table.SplineFlowTable)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | MBL's tabulated flow law: a monotone cubic Hermite spline through ``(dp, flow)`` knots, linearly extrapolated outside them; ``flow(dp)`` always returns MASS flow in kg/s. |
| [`UpstreamDensityPowerLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.upstream.UpstreamDensityPowerLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | `PowerLaw` with `C` scaled by `(rho_upstream / rho_ref) ** m`, upstream by `sign(dp)`. |

## Heads

Terms added to an edge's potential difference (stack, wind, drag).

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`DoorCompartmentHead`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.DoorCompartmentHead)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | The hydrostatic head of one compartment of a discretised door. |
| [`DriverHead`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.DriverHead)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | A head read from a driver: the pre-computed, already batched value `drivers[key]`, one value per edge of `kind`. |
| [`Stack`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.Stack)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | Hydrostatic stack term (CONTAM TN 1887r1 eq. 17 with eq. 64-65 at the path elevation). |
| [`DuctStack`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.DuctStack)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | Hydrostatic term of a duct segment between two junctions: the air column at the density of the junctions' MEAN TEMPERATURE (as ContamX computes it), which at one pressure is the harmonic mean of the two node densities. |
| [`WindProfile`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.WindProfile)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | CONTAM wind pressure profile: Cp versus relative wind angle, periodic in the angle. |
| [`Wind`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.Wind)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | Wind pressure on envelope paths (CONTAM TN 1887r1 section 3.15). |

## Closures

Functions of the state that compute drivers each step (densities, flows, levels).

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`AirHandlerFlows`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.air_handling.AirHandlerFlows)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The closure that prescribes every flow of one air handler each step, by CONTAM's algorithm (see the module) from its design flows and its outdoor-air fraction. |
| [`ControlNetwork`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.ControlNetwork)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Blocks evaluated in order and the actuators that write their outputs into drivers: a model closure that keeps the block outputs in the state. |
| [`DriverReading`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.DriverReading)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `factor * drivers[key][..., *index]`. |
| [`FunctionReading`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.FunctionReading)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `fn(state, drivers)`, for any other reading (the Modelica route's zone temperature). |
| [`StateReading`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.StateReading)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `factor * state[key][..., *index]`, or `default` while the state has no `key` (a flow or a pressure before the first airflow solve). |
| [`FilterTransmission`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.filters.FilterTransmission)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Closure: the species layer's per-step transmission `"<layer>.transmission"`, `(..., b_flow, K)`, for filters that include flow-dependent ones (`UVGIFilter`). |
| [`IdealGasDensity`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.IdealGasDensity)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | rho = P_ref / (R T); P_ref from drivers["P_ref"] if present (CONTAM section 3.18). |
| [`LinearDensity`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.LinearDensity)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Boussinesq: rho = rho_0 (1 - (T - T_0) / T_0), the form the analytical natural- ventilation solutions (Li and Delsante 2001) assume. |
| [`OccupantGeneration`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.occupants.OccupantGeneration)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Closure: the occupants' generation added to `"<layer>.sources"` (kg/s, full node order) of the species `layer` (a `TransportLayer`). |
| [`SpeciesSources`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.SpeciesSources)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Closure: every source's generation summed into `"<layer>.sources"` (kg/s, full node order), added to what an earlier closure or a driver put there, and every removal coefficient into `"<layer>.removal"` (1/s, active interior order), each times its entry of `"<layer>.source_multiplier"`, on its own species. |
| [`EdgeHeads`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.EdgeHeads)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | Adds up head terms (stack, wind, drag, a head read from a driver) on the edges of one potential layer and writes the total, in the layer's edge order, as the driver `"<layer>.edge_head"`; the layer adds it to every edge's potential difference. |

## Sources and storage

Nodal sources, withdrawals and storage.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`BurstSource`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.BurstSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `mass` delivered over the step(s) covering `[t_burst, t_burst + dt)`. |
| [`ConstantSource`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.ConstantSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | S = G - R x (constant coefficient model): G kg/s, R kg/s per unit mass fraction (CONTAM's kg_air/s). |
| [`CutoffSource`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.CutoffSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | S = G (1 - x / x_cut) (cutoff concentration model): G kg/s, x_cut kg/kg. |
| [`DecayingSource`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.DecayingSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | S = G0 exp(-(t - t0) / tau) for t >= t0, else 0. |
| [`DepositionRateSink`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.DepositionRateSink)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | First-order removal at a deposition rate (CONTAM's deposition rate sink): R = k_d rho V, the rate k_d (1/s) on the zone's mass fraction; `rate` a float or tensor. |
| [`DepositionVelocitySink`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.DepositionVelocitySink)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Deposition onto a surface at a deposition velocity (CONTAM's deposition velocity sink): R = v_d A rho, a first-order rate v_d A / V on the zone's mass fraction. |
| [`PeakEmissionSource`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.PeakEmissionSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Emission rising to a peak and decaying (the NRCC peak model): S = a exp(-(ln(t / t_p) / b)^2 / 2), t the time since the start (s), nothing at t <= 0. |
| [`PowerLawDecaySource`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.PowerLawDecaySource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Emission decaying as a power of time (the NRCC power-law model): S = a t_h^(-b) after t_p and a t_ph^(-b) before it, t_h being the time since the start in HOURS (ContamX takes the power of the time in hours, although its file stores t_p in s). |
| [`PressureDrivenSource`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.PressureDrivenSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Entry driven by the pressure difference across the zone's envelope (CONTAM's pressure-driven model: radon, soil gas): S = G max(dP, 0)^n, dP = P_ambient - P_zone at the zone's reference height (Pa). |

| [`write_wth`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.epw.write_wth)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `WeatherFile ContamW 2.0`, one row per sample, the columns `read_wth` reads. |

| [`Absolute`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Absolute)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `\|u\|`. |
| [`Affine`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Affine)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `(u - offset) * gain`: a unit conversion or a gain. |
| [`And`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.And)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | 1 where both inputs are > 0. |
| [`Average`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Average)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The mean of its inputs. |
| [`BelowLimit`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.BelowLimit)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | 1 where `u < limit` (strict), else 0. |
| [`Block`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Block)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | One block. |
| [`Complement`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Complement)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `1 - u` (CONTAM's "inverse" node; not a logical negation). |
| [`Constant`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Constant)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A constant value; a block earlier in the order reads it before its first evaluation too (ContamX presets its constant nodes). |
| [`Divide`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Divide)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `numerator / denominator`; a zero denominator raises naming the block (ContamX stops on it too). |
| [`DriverValue`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.DriverValue)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `drivers[key][..., index]` at this evaluation: a value an `Input` writes (a schedule into `"controls.input"`), or a driver such as `"time"`. |
| [`Excess`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Excess)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `max(0, u - limit)`: how far the input is above the limit. |
| [`ExclusiveOr`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.ExclusiveOr)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | 1 where exactly one input is > 0. |
| [`Hysteresis`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Hysteresis)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | ContamX's hysteresis: with `x` the input clipped to 0..1, the output follows the rising line `max(0, (x - slack) slope)` and the falling line `min(1, x slope)` and stays between them: `y = min(falling, max(rising, y_prev))`. |
| [`Identity`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Identity)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Passes its input on (a signal split, a reported value). |
| [`IncrementalPI`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.IncrementalPI)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | ContamX's PI controller on an error `e`, evaluated once per step of length `dt` (s). |
| [`LimitedPID`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.LimitedPID)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A P or PI controller with a limited output and anti-windup, in continuous time, as MSL 4.1.0's `LimPID` without its derivative part (`Modelica/Blocks/Continuous.mo`, `LimPID`): `v = gain (setpoint_weight u_s - u_m + xi)`, `y = clamp(v, y_min, y_max)` and, with an `integral_time` Ti (s), `d xi/dt = (u_s - u_m + (y - v)/(gain windup_ratio)) / Ti`, `xi(0) = initial_integral`; without one, `xi = 0` (a P controller). |
| [`LowerBandSwitch`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.LowerBandSwitch)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | On (1) once `u > limit + band`, off (0) once `u < limit`, unchanged in between; off at the start (CONTAM's lower band switch). |
| [`Maximum`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Maximum)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The largest of its inputs. |
| [`Minimum`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Minimum)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The smallest of its inputs. |
| [`Or`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Or)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | 1 where either input is > 0. |
| [`Positive`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Positive)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | 1 where `u > 0`, else 0. |
| [`Product`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Product)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The product of its inputs. |
| [`ProportionalControl`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.ProportionalControl)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `clip(gain u, 0, 1)` (CONTAM's proportional controller: the input is an error). |
| [`Sensor`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Sensor)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A reading converted to `x = (value - offset) * scale` and, with a `time_constant` (s), lagged: `y = x + (y_prev - x) exp(-dt / time_constant)`, `y = x` at the first evaluation. |
| [`Shortfall`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Shortfall)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `max(0, limit - u)`: how far the input is below the limit. |
| [`Sum`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.Sum)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `sum_i w_i u_i` (`weights` default 1): CONTAM's add, subtract and sum nodes, and Modelica's Add, Add3, Sum, MultiSum and Feedback. |
| [`UpperBandSwitch`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.UpperBandSwitch)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | On (1) once `u < limit - band`, off (0) once `u > limit`, unchanged in between; off at the start (CONTAM's upper band switch). |
| [`Calendar`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.schedules.Calendar)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Where t = 0 sits in the year, and the CONTAM day type (1-12) of every day. |
| [`ConstantEfficiencyFilter`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.filters.ConstantEfficiencyFilter)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Removes a fixed fraction of each species it lists, nothing of the others. |
| [`DaySchedule`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.schedules.DaySchedule)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | One day of values at times of day: CONTAM's day schedule. |
| [`DuctNetwork`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.ducts.DuctNetwork)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A duct system, described first and then added to a `Network` or a `Component`. |
| [`FilterSeries`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.filters.FilterSeries)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Filters in series (CONTAM's super filter): the air passes each stage in turn, so the pass fraction is the product of the stages' pass fractions. |
| [`Input`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.inputs.Input)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `signal`'s value written into `drivers[key]` at each step. |
| [`KineticReaction`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.species.KineticReaction)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | First-order reactions between species: dx_p/dt += k[p, r] x_r, x in kg/kg. |
| [`Occupancy`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.occupants.Occupancy)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | An occupant's movements: one `OccupancyDay` per CONTAM day type (1-12). |
| [`OccupancyDay`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.occupants.OccupancyDay)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | An occupant's zone over one day: `zones[i]` from `times[i]` (s after midnight) until the next time. |
| [`Occupant`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.occupants.Occupant)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A person (or `multiplier` people) following an `Occupancy`, generating each species in `generation` (kg/s per person; quanta/s for a quanta species) while in the building. |
| [`ParticleFilter`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.filters.ParticleFilter)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Efficiency as a function of particle diameter (CONTAM's simple particle filter, e.g. a MERV curve); zero for a gas. |
| [`UVGIFilter`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.filters.UVGIFilter)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Ultraviolet germicidal irradiation (CONTAM's Penn State UVGI filter element, TN 1887r1 equations uv-1 to uv-9): each species is inactivated with the single-pass efficiency |
| [`Presence`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.occupants.Presence)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | An occupant's location as a signal over `net`'s nodes (full node order, float64, dimensionless). |
| [`Signal`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.schedules.Signal)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A time-varying input: `value(t, calendar)`, a float64 tensor at `t` s since the simulation start (left limit at a jump for t > 0, right value at t == 0), and `breakpoints(lo, hi, calendar)`, the times in (lo, hi) where it jumps or kinks. |
| [`TimeSeries`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.schedules.TimeSeries)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Values at times since the simulation start (s): a measured or computed input. |
| [`WeekSchedule`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.schedules.WeekSchedule)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | CONTAM's week schedule: one `DaySchedule` per day type (1-12). |
| [`AirMedium`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.media.AirMedium)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | An air medium's default state and the two densities its flow elements need. |
| [`LawContext`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.LawContext)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | What a dynamic or implicit constitutive law needs besides its own edge values. |
| [`SplineCurve`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.curve.SplineCurve)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A measured curve y(x) fitted as ContamX fits it (see the module docstring). |

## Functions

Calculations and helpers.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`add_air_handler`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.air_handling.add_air_handler)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Add an air handler to `target` (a `Network` or a `Component`): its two plenums (volumes in m3, temperature `T0` in K) and its edges of `kind`. |
| [`add_large_opening`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.elements.add_large_opening)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | CONTAM's two-opening doorway (DR_PL2, TN 1887r1 eq. 69-70): two orifices of area W H / 2 at z_mid -/+ 2H/9, both oriented a -> b. |
| [`add_zone`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.add_zone)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Add the zone's air node (attributes volume, T0, z_ref, heat_capacity=0) and, if it has a wall, the wall node (heat_capacity) with 'wall' edges zone -> wall -> ambient (ua). |
| [`air_handler`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.components.air_handler)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | CONTAM's simple air-handling system: plenums `supply` and `return` (volumes in m3, temperature `T0` in K), supply points to the ports `supplies[i]` and return points from `returns[j]` (design flows in kg/s), the recirculation, and the outdoor air and exhaust to the shared ambient; `outdoor_air_fraction` and `min_outdoor_air` (kg/s) as in `add_air_handler`. |
| [`air_handler_from_edges`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.air_handling.air_handler_from_edges)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The law and the closure of the air handler whose edges are of `kind` (as `add_air_handler`, or the `.prj` reader, made them). |
| [`air_handler_plenums`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.air_handling.air_handler_plenums)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | (supply plenum, return plenum) of the air handler of `kind`: the recirculation edge's target and source. |
| [`apply_inputs`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.inputs.apply_inputs)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | New drivers with every input's value at `t` written in (inputs bound first). |
| [`assemble_sources`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.assemble_sources)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Sum of every source's explicit rate `source(t, x_full)` (kg/s), full-node order, shape like `x_full`; there is no separate node-count argument. |
| [`bind_inputs`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.inputs.bind_inputs)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `inputs` with every `at` resolved to positions through `model.refs`, checked for overlap: two inputs may not write the same entry of the same driver (raises naming both). |
| [`building_air_change_rate`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.building_air_change_rate)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The building air change rate (1/h), as ContamX writes it to its `.ach` file: every flow entering the conditioned space from outside it, from the ambient or from a zone left out of it, over `density` (1.2041 kg/m3, ContamX's) times the space's volume (the nodes' `"volume"`), times 3600. |
| [`crack`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.components.crack)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A small orifice (m2, m). |
| [`cumulative_exposure`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.cumulative_exposure)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The time integral of `occupant_exposure` from the start: shape (N, ..., K), row 0 zero, in the exposure's unit times s (kg/kg s for mass fractions). |
| [`duct_laws_from_edges`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.ducts.duct_laws_from_edges)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The laws and head terms of the duct edges `DuctNetwork.add_to` made: an `AirDuct` and a `DuctStack` for the segments, a `DuctTerminal`, a `Stack` (at the junction's height) and, when a terminal has a wind profile or a nonzero `Cp`, a `Wind` for the terminals (`profiles` numbers the `WindProfile`s from 1, as for `Wind.from_network`; an edge with neither feels no wind). |
| [`door`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.components.door)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A doorway between two zones (CONTAM's two-opening DR_PL2): terminals `a`, `b` and edges `low`, `high`. |
| [`duct`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.components.duct)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A duct run with a terminal at each end: junctions `ends[0]` at height `z_a` and `ends[1]` at `z_b` (m, relative to the placement), each holding half the duct's air, joined by the segment `segment` (`length`, hydraulic `diameter` and `roughness` in m, `loss` its dynamic loss coefficients), with terminals `terminal_a` and `terminal_b` (area `terminal_area` in m2, the duct's own by default; loss coefficient `terminal_loss`). |
| [`edge_flow`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.edge_flow)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The mass flow (kg/s) of edge `position` of `kind`, along the edge. |
| [`edge_pressure_difference`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.edge_pressure_difference)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The driving pressure difference (Pa) of an edge, from-node minus to-node with the edge's head (`"air.edge_head"`, `KirchhoffLayer.dp`), which `simulate` records as `"air.dp"`. |
| [`fan`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.components.fan)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A fan delivering the mass flow `flow` (kg/s, finite, not negative) whatever the pressures and the height (CONTAM's constant-mass-flow fan): from terminal `a` to `b`, or with `exterior="supply"` from the shared ambient into `a`, or with `exterior="exhaust"` from `a` to the ambient. |
| [`fan_law_from_edges`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.elements.fan_law_from_edges)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | One `FixedFlow` over every edge of `kind`, each edge's mass flow from its `flow` attribute (kg/s), as the `fan` component sets it. |
| [`filter_transmission`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.filters.filter_transmission)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The species layer's `transmission`, `(b_flow, K)`: 1 - efficiency on each filtered edge, 1 elsewhere. |
| [`infection_probability`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.infection_probability)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Wells-Riley: P = 1 - exp(-dose), the dose in quanta (accurate for small doses); dimensionless. |
| [`inhaled_dose`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.inhaled_dose)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | What was breathed in: breathing rate (m3/s) x air density (kg/m3) x the time integral of the mass fraction (kg/kg s; `cumulative_exposure`, not the per-step `occupant_exposure`), in kg, or quanta for a quanta species. |
| [`local_mean_age`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.local_mean_age)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The local mean age of air of every interior row of the layer (s; ContamX's `.age` file gives it in hours): the steady age equation sum_in q tau_upstream - sum_out q tau + M = 0 at every row, tau = 0 at the boundary (the outdoor air), with M the row's air mass: a transport problem with a uniform source of one second per second in every kilogram of air (Sandberg's definition; the method of AIVC Technical Note 34, which ContamX cites). |
| [`mass_orifice`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.elements.mass_orifice)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | F = Cd A sqrt(2 rho dp) [kg/s]: `PowerLaw(C = Cd A sqrt(2 rho), n = 0.5)`. |
| [`node_mass_fraction`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.node_mass_fraction)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A zone's mass fraction (kg/kg) of `species` (position or name) in the species layer's state, read through the layer's own layout (`(..., n_interior)` for one species, `(..., n_interior, K)` for more). |
| [`node_pressure`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.node_pressure)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A node's gauge pressure (Pa): the air layer's potential. |
| [`node_temperature`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.controls.node_temperature)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A node's temperature (K). |
| [`occupant_exposure`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.occupant_exposure)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The occupant's exposure over each step of `history` (from `simulate`): the step mean of the occupied zone's `"<layer>.x"`, linearly interpolated within the step and split at every move; zero out of the building. |
| [`species_history`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.species_history)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `x` (a history `"<layer>.x"` from `simulate`) in the stacked layout `(N, ..., n_i, K)`, and whether it came in reduced. |
| [`occupant_inputs`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.occupants.occupant_inputs)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The inputs `simulate` needs for the occupants that generate something: each one's presence on `"presence.<name>"` (a step mean, the fraction of the step at each node of `net`) and, when it has schedules, the schedule values (1 for an unscheduled species, in the order of its `generation`) on `"generation_multiplier.<name>"`. |
| [`orifice_law_from_edges`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.elements.orifice_law_from_edges)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | One `PowerLaw` over every edge of `kind`, C_e = Cd_e A_e sqrt(2 rho), from the edge attributes `Cd` and `area` (KeyError names a missing one). |
| [`project_calendar`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.simulation.project_calendar)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The calendar of a project's transient run: its run control's start day, time and day type, and the day types of its weather file when it has one. |
| [`reaction_kinetics`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.species.reaction_kinetics)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The species layer's `kinetics`, `(n_i, K, K)`: each node's reaction matrix in the layer's active interior order (`active_interior(net, flow_kinds, [ambient])`), zero where a node has none. |
| [`room`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.components.room)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A zone: air node `air` (m3, K, m) and, with `wall`, a lumped wall node conducting to the shared ambient. |
| [`run_project`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.contamx.run_project)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Run the project AS WRITTEN: its own run control (start, end, time step), weather and ambient-concentration files and schedules; no ambient value is set through the API. |
| [`run_steady`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.contamx.run_steady)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Path net flows [kg/s], zone mass fractions and duct terminal flows (`terminal_flow`, kg/s, out of each terminal into its zone, in junction-number order) after the initial steady-state solve. |
| [`run_transient`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.contamx.run_transient)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | `steps` steps of the project's own time step; results stacked with the initial state first: flow (steps+1, n_paths), mf (steps+1, n_zones, K), terminal_flow (steps+1, n_terminals). |
| [`scatter`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.inputs.scatter)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A new tensor: `base` with `value` written at `index` on the last axis (all of it when `index` is None), batch dimensions broadcast. |
| [`shaft`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.components.shaft)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | A tall space (stairwell, atrium, lift shaft) as a stack of zones, one per level, joined by openings (how stairwells are usually represented in multizone models): node `levels[i]` at z_ref = i * level_height, joined by an opening `slab[i]` (area m2) at the slab between levels i and i+1. |
| [`simulate`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.simulation.simulate)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Time histories at `times` (s since the start, increasing, `times[0] == 0`; the calendar places that start in the year). |
| [`simulate_project`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.simulation.simulate_project)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Run a `.prj` project the way ContamX does: its run control (start, end, time step), its schedules, its weather and ambient-concentration files (resolved next to the `.prj`), with the time step fixed (no step split at a schedule's jump, as in ContamX) and the zone air-mass change when the run control asks for it. |
| [`sources_from_project`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.sources.sources_from_project)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The project's `PrjSource` records (from `read_prj`) -> source objects. |
| [`species_layer`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.species_layer)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Species as mass fractions with zone air mass rho V as capacity (CONTAM convention). |
| [`thermal_layer`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.thermal.thermal_layer)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The heat layer: capacity rho c_p V + heat_capacity per active interior node, carrier c_p on the flow kinds, conduction UA on `conduction_kind` edges (if any exist). |
| [`window`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.components.window)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | An opening in the envelope: a `crack` that is exterior unless told otherwise. |
| [`wells_riley`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.wells_riley)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | The classic steady single-zone form P = 1 - exp(-I q p t / Q): `infectors` I, `quanta_rate` q (quanta/s per infector), `breathing_rate` p (m3/s), `ventilation_rate` Q (m3/s of clean air), `duration` t (s); dimensionless. |
| [`zone_air_change_rate`](../api/building.md#noodl.apps.building_physics.outputs.zone_air_change_rate)<br><small>`noodl.apps.building_physics`</small> | Each zone's air change rate (1/h): all the air flowing into it, from the ambient and from other zones alike, over its air mass, times 3600; the inverse of its nominal time constant, not an outdoor air change rate. |
| [`Orifice`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw.Orifice)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | PowerLaw(C = Cd * A * sqrt(2 / rho), n = 0.5): the sharp-edged orifice equation, as a VOLUME flow in m3/s from `Cd` (dimensionless discharge coefficient), `A` (m2) and `rho` (kg/m3). |
| [`air_viscosity`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.air_duct.air_viscosity)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Dynamic viscosity of air (Pa s) at temperature `T` (K): ContamX's linear law, 1.81625e-5 + 4.92859e-8 (T - 293.15), valid between 253 and 333 K. |
| [`discretized_door`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.discretized_door)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One ``DoorDiscretizedOpen`` as ``nCom`` edges of ``kind``: the compartment element and its head term. |
| [`discretized_operable_door`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.discretized_operable_door)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One ``DoorDiscretizedOperable`` as ``nCom`` edges of ``kind``; see :func:`discretized_door`. |
| [`effective_leakage_area`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.effective_leakage_area)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A regularised power law from an effective leakage area `L` (m2), after MBL. |
| [`medium`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.media.medium)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Look up one of the three air media, by physical name or by Modelica class path. |
| [`open_door_pair`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door.open_door_pair)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Both edges of one ``DoorOpen`` (or of several, with per-door ``src``/``tgt``): the ``"ab"`` edge (path 1) with kind ``f"{kind}_ab"`` and the ``"ba"`` edge (path 2) with kind ``f"{kind}_ba"``, sharing every keyword argument of :class:`OpenDoor`. |
| [`operable_door_pair`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door.operable_door_pair)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Both edges of one ``DoorOperable``; see :func:`open_door_pair`. |
| [`power_law_coefficient`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.power_law_coefficient)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | ``Coefficient_V_flow.mo``/``Coefficient_m_flow.mo``: ``C``/``k`` and ``m`` given directly, with no further formula -- a direct pass-through to :class:`RegularizedPowerLaw`. |
| [`power_law_from_point`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.power_law_from_point)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A regularised power law fitted to one measured (dp, m_flow) pair, after MBL. |
| [`power_law_from_points`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.power_law_from_points)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A regularised power law fitted to two measured (dp, m_flow) pairs, after MBL. |
| [`regularized_orifice`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.regularized_orifice)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A regularised power law for a sharp-edged orifice of area `A` (m2), after MBL. |
| [`step_rate`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.step_rate)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | The rate at which a stored quantity changes over one implicit step: `change / dt` (backward Euler) or `2 change / dt - previous` (trapezoidal, `previous` = the rate at the step start). |
| [`step_rate_factor`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.step_rate_factor)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | d step_rate / d change: `1/dt` (backward Euler) or `2/dt` (trapezoidal). |

Named values and option tables.

| `DEFAULT_TERMINAL_LOSS` | `0.125` |
| `EXHAUST` | `4` |
| `OUTDOOR_AIR` | `3` |
| `RECIRCULATION` | `2` |

| `SUPPLY` | `0` |

## Base classes (for extending)

Subclass these to add a constitutive law, head term, closure, reaction, withdrawal or node storage; see [Extending noodl](../../project/extending/index.md).

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`ConstitutiveLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.ConstitutiveLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Abstract branch law: flow as a function of potential difference. |
| [`ImplicitLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.ImplicitLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | An implicit law: a law whose flow is an unknown of the layer (an ideal source, a flow-controlled pipe, an inductance). |
| [`HeadTerm`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.HeadTerm)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | One additive head on the edges of one kind, computed from the drivers only. |
